repository.name: eslint
repository.description: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code.

issue.body:
space-in-brackets throws an error when an import declaration does not define a variable.

Setting:
`"space-in-brackets": [2, "always"]`

Code:
`import 'xyz';`

```
eslint\lib\rules\space-in-brackets.js:236
            if (firstSpecifier.type === "ImportSpecifier" && lastSpecifier.typ
                              ^
TypeError: Cannot read property 'type' of undefined
    at EventEmitter.ImportDeclaration (eslint\lib\rules\space-in-brackets.js:236:31)
```

Quick assumption at a fix: adding the following to `space-in-brackets#ImportDeclaration`

``` js
if ( node.specifiers.length === 0 ) {
    return;
}
```

From [mozilla-import](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/import):

> Import an entire module for side effects only, without importing any bindings.
> 
> ``` js
> import "my-module.js";
> ```

body: any ETA on release of fixed version?
Possibly this weekend; next weekend if not.
